title: Microsoft Purview Insider Risk Management: discover sensitive data shared to cloud apps and websites via the network layer
summary: Hold for corrections to billing and content capture. Microsoft documents request-based billing for the network collection and processing-unit billing for Insider Risk Management, while content capture requires the classifiers condition to be set to All. The roadmap facts and most of the documented controls are supported.
